consumerBehavior: Prepared execution maps exact resolved inputs and registered actor/installation/policy/trust generation through the injected version-1 port; broker dispatch receipts cannot grant duplicate local execution.

Effect authority preserves full provider requests, consumes a correlated receipt once, and rechecks input, actor/provider, lease, policy, expiry, revocation and cancellation after asynchronous replies and relay consent.
Unavailable producers remain unavailable; unknown settlement and replay fences survive transport reconnection. Producer durable reconciliation and native confinement remain external obligations.
Desktop recovery precedes admission, repeated starts share recovery, corrupt ledgers stay held, shutdown revokes leases and pending effects, and runtime composition rejects mismatched host identity.
The pair runner probes the selected immutable Linux image, checks permission features and artifact identity/architecture/digests, and refuses completion for missing/failed journeys or inner commands.

Declared local fixtures cover exact allow, changed input/policy, wrong actor, expired/revoked authority, replay, disconnect before/after effect, cancellation and unknown settlement. Child-only markers, file contents and loopback connections independently observe denied effects, with a positive control.
